units.source_text: [\[15\]](#part1334.html#w15) 优昙华是佛经中一种想象的花，

en.t: [15] The udumbara is an imaginary flower found in Buddhist scriptures,

units.source_text: 每隔三千年，佛出世时，开花一次。

en.t: and it blooms once every three thousand years, when a Buddha appears in the world.
Here it is used as a metaphor for Genji.
